prompt:
Scene:
A low-angle looking up between two rib-vault stone ribs in a gothic ceiling. Deep shadow in the stone, cyan and violet mid-air, a sense of calm weight.

Subject:
Two slow translucent ribbons of AR scripture text drift between the ribs. Each ribbon is a soft semi-transparent band with faint latinate-glyph shapes printed on its surface (the glyphs must stay unreadable). The ribbons curve in slow S-shapes and cast faint moving light onto the stone beside them. Tiny particles drift off the ribbon edges.

Important details:
Stone ribs must look like real limestone with subtle chisel marks. Ribbons must look physically volumetric — they have thickness, very slight folding, and scatter light from their glyph surface. They are not stickers on a flat plane. Color palette: deep indigo stone, cool cyan ribbon core, warm amber accent on the glyph edges. The glyph shapes must be visually consistent but not form real words.

Use case:
Hologram Cathedral Nave single study 2/5, focusing on AR scripture ribbons between rib-vaults.

Constraints:
No readable text, no watermark, no logos, preserve exact 1:1 aspect ratio, no actual Latin or English words, no readable chapter numbers, no religious insignia brands, no banners, no people.
